construction: native single-trace K increments from matched slots; K_AB=K0+dA+dB; K_ABC=K_AB+dC
causal_control: replace native b_AB and b_ABC by exact additive sums of the corresponding single-trace b increments, keeping K_AB/K_ABC and all current variables unchanged

primary_hypotheses.H3_additive_b_removes_b_interaction: mean fraction of b interaction removed >0.999 and >90% seeds exceed 0.999
primary_hypotheses.H4_additive_b_removes_action_interaction: mean fraction of action interaction removed >0.99 and >90% seeds exceed 0.99

secondary_only: fraction of field coordinates crossing the median criterion

interpretation_rule.all_pass: a third trace contextually changes the operational contribution of an existing A+B field without altering their stored K increments; the effect is mediated by the nonadditive K->b field readout
interpretation_rule.H1_H2_pass_H3_H4_fail: third-trace modulation exists but mediation by b readout is not established
interpretation_rule.fail_H1_or_H2: the contextual reweighting effect is too small relative to the direct C effect to support the claim

scope_warning: reactor-specific distributed-readout mechanism; not a claim of physical fields, biology, phenomenology, or consciousness
